summary: Every operation is present in order with correct welding parameters, dimensions, coating thickness and tapping depth, and the header revision and dates are right. It fails because it adds PPAP specs the golden does not have (0.8 mm AWS 70S-6 wire, SS 7265/7651 coating standards, 80 RPM tapping speed, per-shift sampling, extra gauges, a nut-missing rework row). Tack count on the nut is given as 3 per nut, the second sub-assembly has no weld-quality check, and dent rework allows rejection instead of plastic-mallet repair.
